why: Slayer of Tyrants is on the Allarus Custodians datasheet (GW's name; NR's 'Slayers' is a deviation). Text matches Wahapedia.
Vexilla is the Allarus wargear ability (one model has it: NR line 3x Allarus: Vexilla on one). Text matches Wahapedia.

GW Trajann keywords: INFANTRY, CHARACTER, EPIC HERO, IMPERIUM; Allarus: INFANTRY, IMPERIUM, TERMINATOR. ALLARUS CUSTODIANS (name keyword, NR/lite-knights convention) and TERMINATOR come from the led unit (core 19.03). Correct.
Trajann 265 (Wahapedia 1 model 265); 3 Allarus 270 (1st-2nd unit bracket; Dread Host has 2 Allarus units, 270 and 180). Total 535 matches NR.
As lite-knights: FNP 5+ is Trajann's own core ability; per 19.04 FAQ it applies only to him. Feel No Pain 5+* (Aegis, vs mortal wounds) stays whole-unit.

NR: Trajann Eagle's Scream + Watcher's Axe; 3 Allarus each Balistus grenade launcher + Castellan Axe (one with Vexilla). Names follow NR.
Leader is the Shield-Captain's; GW's list (Wahapedia) includes SENTINEL GUARD SODALITY, which the NR (old codex) text lacks while NR still attaches him. GW wins.
Text says 'In your opponent's Shooting phase' -> Shooting, their turn. Correct.
GW header: 'Vengeful Surge (Once per battle, per unit)'. Correct.
Vengeful Surge is on the Shield-Captain datasheet.
GW header: 'Master of Ka’tahs (Once per battle round, per unit)'. Correct; no phase named, so untagged phase is right, and ka'tah options are not spelled out.
Master of Ka’tahs is on the Shield-Captain datasheet (GW's name; NR's 'Master of the Ka'tahs' is a deviation).

Shield-Captain's own Praesidium Shield ('Attacks allocated to this model have -1 D'), distinct from the Sentinel Guard ability of the same name. He keeps the shield with the Paragon Blade option (GW wargear: only the Pyrithite Spear is replaced).
Faithful to 'Attacks allocated to this model have -1 D'; '(the Shield-Captain)' only names 'this model' on an attached-unit screen, no added reading. Defensive always-on, no timing label.
Stand Vigil is on the Sentinel Guard Sodality datasheet.

'This unit' is a bodyguard ability: applies to the whole attached unit incl. the Shield-Captain (core 19.04). kind all (ranged+melee), cond objective. Correct.
GW Sentinel Guard keywords INFANTRY, BATTLELINE, IMPERIUM, TRUSTED SENTINEL (+ name keyword per NR convention); Shield-Captain has none of the three. Correct.
Shield-Captain 180 (1st unit) + Praesidium Shield 25 = 205 (Wahapedia wargear cost); Sentinel Guard 3 models 240 (1st-3rd). 445 matches NR.
